description: This Java source file defines the BOMTree class, representing an in-memory hierarchical structure of a bill of materials (BOM) for products. It provides methods for constructing BOM trees through various exploration modes (explosion, implosion), managing nodes, and creating manufacturing orders based on the BOM structure.

classes.name: BOMTree
classes.description: Represents an in-memory hierarchical BOM structure for products, supporting tree traversal, explosion, implosion, and manufacturing order creation.

methods.name: BOMTree
methods.description: Constructor that builds a BOM tree by reading downward (explosion), handling virtual products and product features, and initializing the root node based on product data.

methods.name: BOMTree
methods.description: Constructor that builds a BOM tree based on specified traversal type (explosion, single level explosion, manufacturing-specific explosion, or implosion).

methods.name: manufacturedAsProduct
methods.description: Private method to retrieve the product association indicating manufacturing relation, filtered by date.

methods.name: hasBom
methods.description: Checks if the given product has a bill of materials defined for the specified BOM type.

methods.name: isConfigured
methods.description: Determines if the BOM tree has been fully configured, i.e., contains no virtual or placeholder nodes.

methods.name: getRootQuantity
methods.description: Gets the quantity of the root product in the BOM tree.

methods.name: setRootQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the root product.

methods.name: getRootAmount
methods.description: Gets the total amount associated with the root product in the BOM tree.

methods.name: setRootAmount
methods.description: Sets the total amount for the root product.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root node of the BOM tree.

methods.name: getInDate
methods.description: Returns the date associated with the BOM tree for validity filtering.

methods.name: getBomTypeId
methods.description: Returns the BOM type identifier used for this structure.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Overloaded methods to produce a string or list representation of the BOM tree nodes for debugging or breakdown purposes.

methods.name: sumQuantities
methods.description: Aggregates quantities across the BOM tree into a map for summarized explosion.

methods.name: getAllProductsId
methods.description: Collects and returns a list of all productIds in the BOM tree.

methods.name: createManufacturingOrders
methods.description: Creates manufacturing orders for nodes that require production, based on the BOM structure.

methods.name: getProductsInPackages
methods.description: Collects products within packages according to the BOM structure.
